name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 3px focus ring to every interactive element that receives keyboard focus, using a high-contrast color like #005FCC on a white background. This ensures keyboard users can see where they are on the page without relying on color alone, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for focus indicators. The trade-off is a slight visual clutter on dense screens, but it’s necessary for users who navigate without a mouse.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 3px ring may not work on dark backgrounds or complex layouts—it could blend in or clash. Better: Use a 2px solid ring with 4px offset, tested on both light/dark modes. Settle by testing with real users in both themes.

name: Ramp
text:
Add a 2px solid focus ring with a 4px outer offset, colored #005FCC on light backgrounds and #00BFFF on dark backgrounds. This keeps the ring visible in both themes without relying on a single color, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements. The trade-off is slightly more CSS complexity, but it ensures the focus indicator remains usable everywhere.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 2px ring with 4px offset still fails on low-contrast dark backgrounds where #00BFFF blends into deep blues or blacks. Better: Use a 3px ring with 2px offset in both themes, but ensure it’s always #005FCC with a 1px white outline. Settle by testing on actual devices in dark mode with colorblind simulators.
